mapper.select: SELECT o.pay_price, o.refund_status, e.current_stage, TIMESTAMP(s.delivery_date, s.end_time) AS promised_time, (SELECT MAX(p.create_time) FROM eb_flower_order_progress p WHERE p.order_id = o.order_id AND p.stage = 'COMPLETED') AS completed_time FROM eb_store_order o INNER JOIN eb_flower_order_ext e ON e.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN eb_flower_delivery_slot s ON s.id = e.slot_id WHERE o.paid = 1 AND o.is_del = 0 AND o.is_system_del = 0 AND o.pay_time >= #{start} AND o.pay_time < #{end}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM eb_store_order o INNER JOIN eb_flower_order_ext e ON e.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.refund_status IN (1, 3) AND o.is_system_del = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eb_store_order o INNER JOIN eb_flower_order_ext e ON e.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.is_system_del=0 AND o.create_time >= #{start} AND o.create_time < #{end}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.current_stage='WAIT_ACCEPT'),0) AS waitAccept, COALESCE(SUM(e.current_stage IN ('WAIT_PRODUCTION','PRODUCING')),0) AS waitProduction, COALESCE(SUM(e.current_stage IN ('WAIT_DELIVERY','DELIVERING')),0) AS waitDelivery FROM eb_store_order o INNER JOIN eb_flower_order_ext e ON e.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.paid=1 AND o.refund_status=0 AND o.is_del=0 AND o.is_system_del=0

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.refund_price),0) FROM eb_store_order o INNER JOIN eb_flower_order_ext e ON e.order_id=o.order_id INNER JOIN (SELECT oid,MAX(create_time) AS completed_time FROM eb_store_order_status WHERE change_type='refund_price' GROUP BY oid) r ON r.oid=o.id WHERE o.refund_status=2 AND o.is_system_del=0 AND r.completed_time >= #{start} AND r.completed_time < #{end}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS label, SUM(o.pay_price) AS amount, COUNT(1) AS order_count FROM eb_store_order o INNER JOIN eb_flower_order_ext e ON e.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.paid = 1 AND o.refund_status = 0 AND o.is_del = 0 AND o.is_system_del = 0 AND o.pay_time >= #{start} AND o.pay_time < #{end} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY MIN(o.pay_time)

SELECT i.product_id, i.product_name AS name, i.image, SUM(i.pay_num) AS quantity, SUM(i.price * i.pay_num) AS amount FROM eb_store_order_info i INNER JOIN eb_store_order o ON o.id = i.order_id INNER JOIN eb_flower_order_ext e ON e.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.paid = 1 AND o.refund_status = 0 AND o.is_del = 0 AND o.is_system_del = 0 AND o.pay_time >= #{start} AND o.pay_time < #{end} GROUP BY i.product_id, i.product_name, i.image
ORDER BY amount DESC, quantity DESC, i.product_id ASC ORDER BY quantity DESC, amount DESC, i.product_id ASC
LIMIT 5

SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(s.start_time, '%H:%i'), '-', DATE_FORMAT(s.end_time, '%H:%i')) AS label, COUNT(1) AS order_count FROM eb_flower_order_ext e INNER JOIN eb_flower_delivery_slot s ON s.id = e.slot_id INNER JOIN eb_store_order o ON o.order_id = e.order_id WHERE o.paid = 1 AND o.refund_status = 0 AND o.is_del = 0 AND o.is_system_del = 0 AND o.pay_time >= #{start} AND o.pay_time < #{end} GROUP BY s.start_time, s.end_time ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 5
